_comment: Sample $attrs for the generic Prochaines étapes (nextStepsCard) card, in the NextStepsAction OUTPUT shape (ordered steps[]). THE AGENT SUPPLIES THE STEPS: it sends a JSON `spec` (a steps array) to Get_Next_Steps; the Apex action normalizes it (auto-numbering order) into this render-time payload so the widget binds with plain forEach only, rendering identically in this preview and in the production HXL runtime. This snapshot shows the ACTIONABLE mode (selectable=true): each step gets a checkbox (id step_<stepId>, initial state from `selected`) and the footer shows Confirm/Cancel, so the user picks which steps to act on before submitting. The same card serves meeting follow-ups, deal action plans, onboarding checklists, service resolution paths, and advisor next-best-actions. A reference snapshot — illustrative values.
